content: {"like": ["Watching Farrah Fawcett strut around in revealing garb is nice.", "Getting lost in the movie and not thinking of if a movie is good or bad, just enjoying it for what it is."], "dislike": ["Plot holes and bad dialog/acting fill the movie completely to the point of laughable.", "Watching Farrah Fawcett act is pretty painful as always.", "Kurt Douglass comes off as a creepy old man who seems to have FF on this base for nothing more then being a sex slave.", "The biggest problem is the plot and how the movie is set up in the beginning; they never answer why Captain Benson kills Captain James.", "No one seems to notice that the original captain was murdered and this guy took his place for like weeks on Saturn 3.", "The robot is a hulking mass of metal and moves as slow as a sloth, making it comedic to watch them run around in terror and fear when it’s painfully obvious there are many ways to run circles around it and disable it."]}
